academy_trials.name: Academy Trials
academy_trials.description: Begin your journey at the Summoning Academy. Master the fundamentals of summoning and prove your worth.

combat_arena.name: Combat Arena
combat_arena.description: Test battles for core combat mechanics. Uses fixed decks - no collection required.

affinity.name: Trial of Affinities
affinity.description: Welcome to the Academy of Summoning Arts. Headmaster Merlin awaits in the crystal chamber—the ancient stones will measure your connection to the elemental forces. This trial will reveal your path, initiate. Choose wisely, for in the art of summoning, all choices endure.

first_summon.name: First Summon
first_summon.description: With your affinity revealed, the time has come to bind your first companion. Headmaster Merlin presents two candidates, each eager to join your journey. Remember, initiate: what you bind, stays bound. Choose your partner carefully.

caravan_tutorial.name: A Fortuitous Encounter
caravan_tutorial.description: A cheerful merchant has set up camp along the path. Mr. Merriweather offers supplies for your journey ahead.

first_trial.name: The First Trial
first_trial.description: Your affinity chosen, your companion bound—Headmaster Merlin now calls you to the training grounds. This first trial will test whether theory translates to practice. Prove your worth, initiate, and earn your place among the Academy's summoners.

charge_tutorial.name: The Ironhide Slime
charge_tutorial.description: A peculiar slime blocks the path ahead. Merlin senses something unusual about its defenses. Learn to use tactical commands wisely.

arena_fire_elemental.name: Fire Elemental Test
arena_fire_elemental.description: Test the new Fire Elemental unit. Watch it bob and float across the battlefield.

arena_melee_basics.name: Melee Basics
arena_melee_basics.description: Slime vs slime. Test basic melee combat and unit movement.

arena_ranged_intro.name: Ranged Introduction
arena_ranged_intro.description: Fire units with ranged attackers. Test ranged combat mechanics.

arena_mixed_tactics.name: Mixed Tactics
arena_mixed_tactics.description: Combined melee and ranged units. Test combined arms tactics.

arena_full_combat.name: Full Combat
arena_full_combat.description: All unit types including structures. Comprehensive combat test.

fire_elemental.name: Fire Elemental
fire_elemental.description: A floating spirit of pure flame. Hovers across the battlefield, burning all in its path.

fire_titan.name: Fire Titan
fire_titan.description: A colossal spirit of ancient flame. Towers over the battlefield, absorbing damage while scorching all who approach.

fire_elemental_swarm.name: Fire Swarm
fire_elemental_swarm.description: Unleash a horde of flame spirits. Ten smaller fire elementals surge forth to overwhelm the enemy.

tidal_resilience.name: Tidal Resilience
tidal_resilience.description: The flow of water grants increased vitality. +10% max health.

wind_affinity.name: Wind Affinity
wind_affinity.description: +10% wind damage. Wind units deal 10% more damage.

swift_casting.name: Swift Casting
swift_casting.description: Wind carries your commands faster. +10% cast speed.

earth_affinity.name: Earth Affinity
earth_affinity.description: +10% earth damage. Earth units deal 10% more damage.

stone_fortitude.name: Stone Fortitude
stone_fortitude.description: The resilience of stone reduces incoming damage.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.description: Battle experience has hardened your resolve.

mana_well.name: Mana Well
mana_well.description: Your mana pool has expanded through practice.

fortune_favors.name: Fortune Favors
fortune_favors.description: Luck smiles upon those who take risks.

fortune_favors_bold.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
fortune_favors_bold.description: Choosing the path of chance grants fortified vitality. +50 Health

charge_intro.speaker: Merlin
charge_intro.line_1: A wild slime blocks your path. This one looks... different. Tougher.

charge_tanky_slime.speaker: Merlin
charge_tanky_slime.line_1: By the stones! This slime's hide is incredibly thick. Your units' attacks barely scratch it!

charge_explain.speaker: Merlin
charge_explain.line_1: Use your Charge card! Command a unit to rush past the slime to the enemy core. Sometimes victory isn't about fighting—it's about strategy.

merriweather_greeting.speaker: Mr. Merriweather
merriweather_greeting.line_1: Why, hello there, young summoner! What wonderful timing! I'm Mr. Merriweather, traveling merchant and purveyor of fine magical goods. I've journeyed far to bring these quality wares to aspiring summoners such as yourself!

merriweather_offer.speaker: Mr. Merriweather
merriweather_offer.line_1: Please, take your time browsing! Every item in my collection has been carefully curated. I pride myself on offering only the finest selections at fair prices. After all, helping young summoners succeed is its own reward!

merriweather_closing.speaker: Mr. Merriweather
merriweather_closing.line_1: Do let me know if anything catches your eye! I'll be in the area for a while—there are several other summoners I'm hoping to assist today. Such a joy to support the next generation of summoners!

merlin_summoner_intro.speaker: Merlin
merlin_summoner_intro.line_1: Welcome to the Academy, Initiate. I am Merlin, your Headmaster.
merlin_summoner_intro.line_2: Before we begin your trials, you must select your path—the elemental affinity that will shape your journey as a summoner.
merlin_summoner_intro.line_3: Each path offers unique strengths. Earth brings resilience, Fire passion, Water adaptability, Air swiftness... and for the daring, there is always the path of chance.
merlin_summoner_intro.line_4: This choice will define your approach to the summoning arts. Choose wisely, but do not hesitate.

merlin_first_card_intro.speaker: Merlin
merlin_first_card_intro.line_1: Welcome to the Academy, Initiate. I am Merlin, your Headmaster.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_2: You stand at the beginning of your journey as a summoner—a path of great power and greater responsibility.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_3: Here at the Academy, we teach one principle above all: choices have consequences. What you bind, stays bound.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_4: Your first choice lies before you. Select your starting companion—Fire Recruit or Ember Slinger.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_5: Choose with intention, Initiate. This decision is permanent, as all true summoning must be.

first_trial_intro.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_intro.line_1: Welcome to the training grounds, Initiate.
first_trial_intro.line_2: Your affinity chosen, your companion bound—now we put theory into practice.
first_trial_intro.line_3: Before you lies a simple trial. A single slime awaits beyond.
first_trial_intro.line_4: Show me you understand the fundamentals. Victory here earns your place among the Academy's summoners.

first_trial_card_explain.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_card_explain.line_1: These cards summon units to defend your base.
first_trial_card_explain.line_2: Each shows its mana cost, attack, and health.
first_trial_card_explain.line_3: You start with 10 mana—enough for several summons.

first_trial_core_explain.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_core_explain.line_2: Beat them before they reach your base. Destroy their core to win!

first_trial_enemy_appears.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_enemy_appears.line_2: If it reaches your base, you'll take damage.

first_trial_play_prompt.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_play_prompt.line_1: You try—play a card to defend!
first_trial_play_prompt.line_2: Drag it onto the battlefield to summon your unit.

simple_greeting.speaker: Friendly Wizard
simple_greeting.line_2: Welcome to the world of card battles.
simple_greeting.line_3: May your deck be strong and your mana plentiful!

chain_start.speaker: Old Sage
chain_start.line_1: This is the beginning of a longer story...
chain_start.line_2: It will continue in the next dialogue.

chain_end.speaker: Old Sage
chain_end.line_1: And here we are at the conclusion.
chain_end.line_2: Dialogue chains allow for multi-part conversations!
chain_end.line_3: This is very useful for storytelling.

choice_example.speaker: Mysterious Merchant
choice_example.line_1: Ah, another traveler seeks my wares!
choice_example.line_2: Will you join me on this journey?
